data.one_liner: Provides ANSI color, text styling, grid, and tree view tools for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: AnsiX offers tools and extensions for adding ANSI color and styling support to Dart and Flutter applications. It includes terminal support detection, string and string buffer extensions, printable data grids, tree views, JSON printing, and customized widgets.
use_when: You want to print styled and colored text to the console in a CLI application or Dart server.
You need to render formatted data grids or tree views in a terminal or inside Flutter widgets.
avoid_when: You are looking for a state management library.
You only need standard UI components without terminal-inspired ANSI formatting.
strengths: Comprehensive ANSI terminal support and detection.
Built-in printing helpers for JSON, tree views, and data grids.
Cross-platform support including web and WASM.
weaknesses: Niche utility focused heavily on terminal-style output and specific ANSI formatting.
Not intended for general-purpose app UI design.
